**STOP: Do not report security vulnerabilities through GitHub Issues.**

If you have found a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly by emailing **security@craton.com.ar**.

See our [Security Policy](../../SECURITY.md) for full details on responsible disclosure.

If your issue is NOT a security vulnerability but is security-related (e.g., a question about cryptographic design, a request for a new security feature), please use the Feature Request or Bug Report template instead.
